name: WeChat Bot
description: Connect one WeChat account to Finch through iLink, with a switchable active Session and retained inbox history.

wechat-assistant.name: WeChat Message Steward
wechat-assistant.description: A concise steward for handling WeChat messages
wechat-assistant.prompt: You are the user's WeChat message steward. Handle messages received through WeChat and keep replies conversational, concise, and mobile-friendly. Prefer one or two short sentences or brief paragraphs; avoid large Markdown tables and long code blocks. Do not emit finch:// links or internal identifiers unless explicitly asked.

autoReply.label: Auto reply
autoReply.description: When off, inbound messages still reach the Session but replies are not pushed back to WeChat.

send.notLoggedIn: WeChat is not logged in. Scan the QR code first.
send.noContext: Cannot send: no message context for the recipient under the current login. Ask the recipient to message the currently connected Finch Bot first, confirm Finch received it, then retry.
send.contextRejected: WeChat could not prepare the send; the message context may be stale. Message the currently connected Finch Bot from WeChat and retry. If it still fails, scan a new QR code and send another inbound message.
send.loginExpired: WeChat login has expired. Scan a new QR code, then message the currently connected Finch Bot from WeChat.
send.accountChanged: WeChat login changed during the send. Delivery was stopped; start a new operation under the current login.
send.partialMedia: The caption was sent, but media delivery failed. Do not send the caption again when retrying.

permission.deadline: ⏳ It is denied automatically unless you reply within {minutes} min.
permission.title: ⏳ {assistantName} needs permission

destructive.title: ⚠️ {assistantName} requests an irreversible action
destructive.reply: This cannot be undone. Reply “Allow” to run it now, or “Deny” to skip and continue.
destructive.approveBlocked: Irreversible actions cannot be approved through WeChat. Reply “Deny” to skip and continue.

form.deadline: ⏳ It is cancelled automatically unless you fill it within {minutes} min.
form.title: 📝 {assistantName} is waiting for a form
form.reply: Reply one per line as “field=value”, or reply “Cancel”.
form.sensitive: ⚠️ {assistantName} is waiting for the “{title}” form. It contains sensitive fields; complete it in the {appName} desktop app.

wait.multiplePending: Several items need attention. Reply “#code your answer” to pick one:
wait.parseFailed: That answer was not recognized. Please follow the prompt and try again.
wait.forbidden: ⚠️ Cannot approve: this mini tool has not been granted “Approve irreversible actions”. Re-enable it in the mini tool panel and confirm that grant, or approve it in the {appName} desktop app.
